title: Stagalbog Cave

[[Image:Stagalbog Cave.jpg|thumb|300px|Stagalbog Cave]]

A large cave located in the [[Stagalbog]] in eastern [[Swamp of Sorrows]].  Many [[murlocs]] of the Marsh tribe live here, with their leader, the [[Swamp Talker]].
